data.abstract: Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) aim to create a unified model that describes all major classes of (bio)molecules at quantum-mechanical accuracy. We present SO3LR Tauri, a family of MLFFs developed toward this goal, coupling a fast SO3krates network to explicit, physics-based interaction modules: pair-specific short-range repulsion, environment-dependent dispersion, and electrostatics, each improved beyond its original formulation. The models are trained on 148 million structures spanning 85 elements, drawn from several quantum-chemical datasets. Against coupled-cluster references, the models accurately reproduce nucleobase-pair and charged protein–ligand interactions, carbohydrate conformer ordering, and molecular dipoles. They also resolve the transition pathways of organic and enzymatic reactions. Dynamical simulations recover experimental densities of water and organic solvents, the hydration structure of mono- and divalent ions, the pKa values of amino-acid side chains, and the structure and dynamics of proteins, membranes, nucleic acids, glycoproteins, and metal-containing biomolecules, all without system-specific fitting. Released in three sizes, the models reach 0.7–3.2 µs/atom and scale to 27–84 million atoms on a single GPU. Much work remains to be done: achieving predictive accuracy for static and dynamic liquid properties, reaction barriers, coverage of chemical and conformational space, and the sampling and inference speed needed to describe biomolecular processes.

algorithms.name: SO3LR Tauri
problems_solved: 解决经典力场需针对每类生物分子单独拟合参数的问题
解决纯神经网络力场在长程相互作用和极端条件下物理行为不准确的问题
解决单一量子化学数据集无法覆盖生物相关元素及成键的问题
algorithms.mechanism: 耦合SO3krates消息传递骨干网络与显式物理相互作用模块（短程排斥、静电、色散），通过多任务头结合不同理论水平的训练数据。
algorithms.why_it_works: 显式物理模块保证了正确的渐近衰减行为（1/r和1/r6），避免了深层消息传递网络在长程效应学习上的不足，同时NLH势函数确保了短程排斥的物理正确性。
applicable_to: 覆盖周期表85种元素的通用模拟
limitations: 静态和动态液体性质的预测精度仍有待提高
反应势垒的预测精度不足
化学和构象空间的覆盖范围有限
采样和推理速度尚不足以描述所有生物分子过程
